name: backup-review
title: Backup assurance review
for_each: select id,code,name from clients order by code

sections.title: Client review
sections.sql: select name,owner,review_due,coalesce(nullif(security_evidence,''),'Not recorded') security_evidence,coalesce(retention_days::text,'Not recorded') retention_days from clients where id=$1

sections.title: Recorded backup results
sections.sql: select code,name,state,to_char(last_result,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') last_result_utc,to_char(last_success,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') last_success_utc from v_morning where client_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Restore exercise position
sections.sql: select code,name,restore_state,to_char(last_restore,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') last_restore_utc,to_char(restore_due,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') restore_due_utc from v_morning where client_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Follow-up work
sections.sql: select a.code,a.name,a.owner,a.due_on,a.status,a.evidence from actions a join jobs j on j.id=a.job_id where j.client_id=$1 order by a.due_on

name: restore-record
title: Restore exercise record
for_each: select id,code,name from jobs order by code

sections.title: Exercises recorded
sections.sql: select tested_at,outcome,recovery_minutes,evidence,actor from restore_tests where job_id=$1 order by tested_at desc
